 COMMON ORDER
The lands that belonged to the petitioners were acquired for public purposes.
An award was passed by the Special District Revenue Officer / Land Acquisition Officer in a proceeding dated 31.01.2023.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.12010 & 10320 of 2023 2.
Not satisfied with the award of compensation, the petitioners filed an objection before the District Collector on 10.02.2023.
In respect of such objections, the competent authority/ District Collector has to refer the matter for adjudication before the Court concerned under Section 20 of the Land Acquisition Act.

3. In the present case, the petitioners have submitted the objections by affixing prescribed fee on 10.02.2023 and that being the factum, the District Collector is directed to refer the dispute for adjudication under the provisions of the Act within a period of four (4) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
4. Petitioners are at liberty to adjudicate the issues on merits and in accordance with the law before the competent Authority.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.12010 & 10320 of 2023
5.With these directions
, the Writ Petitions stand disposed of.
No costs.
